verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a first-party MCP server that lets your own AI agents work with its payment platform. Per the docs, agents can query a designated set of Core API endpoints, issue virtual cards, set spend controls and query transactions in natural language. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, setup/auth/transport details, and coverage beyond a designated subset of Core API endpoints.
